messages:
niko: quick flag: PR #5123 (function/tool-calling examples) has a canonical example that assumes `result.details` is always an object. some LLM outputs return an array for that field and our SDK parser test started failing. cc @sophia @jia

sophia: can you paste the failing trace?

niko: failing unit: `parseFunctionOutput` expecting object, got array. trace: 
```
Error: Expected object at path result.details, got array
    at validateOutput (/repo/sdk/src/validator.ts:88)
    at parseFunctionOutput (/repo/sdk/src/parse.ts:210)
```

jia: ah yes we've seen two legit producer shapes across customers: {result:{details:{...}}} and {result:{details:[{...}, ...]}}. docs should show both and recommend a normalization.

sophia: agree. propose we: 1) add paired examples (object + array) 2) add JSON Schema using `oneOf` so validators allow either 3) include small JS/Python normalizer snippets and link to SDK helper.

niko: draft schema suggestion: 
```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"result":{"type":"object","properties":{"details":{"oneOf":[{"type":"object"},{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object"}}]}}}}}
```

jia: for the docs snippet, include a short explanation: "normalize to array of objects for downstream code simplicity" and then show a minimal coercion, e.g.:
```js
// ensure details is an array of objects
const d = resp.result?.details;
resp.result.details = Array.isArray(d) ? d : (d ? [d] : []);
```

sophia: also include Python version (many customers run backends in Python):
```py
# normalize details -> list[dict]
d = resp.get("result", {}).get("details")
if d is None:
    resp.setdefault("result", {})["details"] = []
elif isinstance(d, dict):
    resp["result"]["details"] = [d]
```

niko: SDK side: i'll open a tiny helper `normalize_details` and tests. i'll link the SDK PR from the docs PR. sam (cc) can you make sure the helper lives in `sdk/util/normalizers.ts` and export it for users?

sophia: one more item: add a short migration guide bullet under "non-breaking shape changes" that recommends authors avoid switching between singular object and array across versions. show example and recommended deprecation path.

jia: docs-bot: please attach the grammar note about `oneOf` vs `anyOf` — prefer `oneOf` here since we expect either object or array exclusively. include sentence explaining validators semantics.

docs-bot: PR #5123 updated by sophia: added dual examples, JSON Schema `oneOf`, JS/Python normalizers, and migration note. requested review from @niko and @jia. :white_check_mark:

merge-bot: docs-ci: lint/links passed on branch sophia/dual-output-examples (checks: md-lint, md-links)

niko: thanks — i'll open the SDK PR now and add tests for both shapes, will ping once linked. aiming EOD.

sophia: tiny nit: in the JS snippet, add a short comment explaining why we coerce (LLM variability); otherwise LGTM.

jia: done. will review docs once SDK PR is linked.

niko: great, closing loop shortly. :thumbsup:
